title: L2TP connection stopped working
body: Since yesterday, when I did 'pacman -Syu' on my Arch Linux (KDE Plasma), L2TP connection to company's VPN doesn't work anymore. Last succesful connection was on 7th of September (4 days ago). I have a few Arch Linux VM's with that same VPN connection set and those work just fine since I didn't update them yet. Error I get: Starting the service providing the VPN connection 'B VPN' failed. I've reinstalled networkmanager-strongswan, strongswan, networkmanager-l2tp, networkmanager-vpn-plugin-l2tp and xl2tpd packages but nothing helped. I've checked both passwords (pre-shared key (PSK) and my VPN password) and everything is just fine. If I can give you any additional info, just ask me. Thank you for your help in advance!
